race.description: Raine & Horne Eastern Shore Mdn Plate
race.comment: MISS STRAT (11) should be suited by the drop back from 1200m to 1100m, and she has found the right sort of race fifth up from a spell. Hard to beat in this. THERMAL MISS (12) will be peaking third up from a spell, and she has shown enough to say that she can win a race like this at short notice. Each way. FIERCE SPIRIT (5) resumed with a big effort for second here 12 days ago, will have to contend with a tougher gate this time. He won't have to improve by much to be the winner here. UNCLE MARK (8) has improved in each of his 3 trials to date, and he makes his debut from a handy gate, in a very winnable race. Follow the early market support. THE BIG FELLA (3) resumes from a spell, and only needs to run up to his trial form to be a threat in this. Include in all combos.
